cloudSync.title: Settings backup
cloudSync.description: Back up contacts, rules, Kanban cards and notes, and account details to WebDAV. Account passwords, sign-in tokens and API keys can be included, encrypted with a separate backup password.
cloudSync.restoreNotice: Without the backup encryption password, only part of the backup is restored. Enter it to also restore account passwords, sign-in tokens and translation API keys, if the backup contains them.
cloudSync.restoreSuccess: Backup restored. Reconnect email accounts and translation providers to continue.
cloudSync.restoreSuccessWithSecrets: Backup restored, including saved credentials. Existing sign-ins and accounts with local mail were kept.
cloudSync.restoreConfirm: This replaces local rules, Kanban cards and notes, and contacts with the backup, merges account details, and restores encrypted credentials if present. This can't be undone.
cloudSync.encryptionWarning: Note: regular settings are uploaded unencrypted (as JSON). Credentials are encrypted only when you turn on the option below. Use a WebDAV server you trust.
cloudSync.scopeNotice: WebDAV backup includes contacts, settings, rules, Kanban cards and Kanban notes. Optionally, account passwords, sign-in tokens and translation API keys can be included, encrypted. Message bodies and attachments are not included, except text you saved in a Kanban note.
cloudSync.includeSecrets: Include account passwords, sign-in tokens and API keys
cloudSync.includeSecretsDesc: These credentials are encrypted with the password below before upload. You'll need the same password to restore them on another device.
cloudSync.secretPassphrasePlaceholder: Required to back up or restore credentials
cloudSync.secretPassphraseRequired: Enter a backup encryption password to include account passwords, sign-in tokens and API keys.
cloudSync.restoreSecretPassphraseRequired: This backup contains encrypted credentials. Enter the backup encryption password before restoring.
cloudSync.autoBackupFillFields: Fill in WebDAV credentials above to enable auto-backup.
cloudSync.secretPassphraseTooShort: The backup encryption password must be at least 12 characters.
cloudSync.weakPassphraseHint: Your saved backup encryption password is shorter than 12 characters. Backups still work, but please set a stronger password.
cloudSync.autoBackupCredentialsRequired: Enter a WebDAV URL, username and password before turning on automatic backup.
cloudSync.autoBackupSecretPassphraseRequired: Enter a backup encryption password to include sensitive credentials.

about.title: About
about.description: A local-first desktop email client built with Rust and React. Mail, search index, and attachments stay on your device. No telemetry. Outbound traffic happens only when you use a feature that requires it: mail sync with your provider, translation, WebDAV settings backup, external message images you choose to load, or a manual GitHub update check.
about.features: Supports Gmail, Outlook, IMAP, and POP3 accounts. Includes Kanban board, full-text search, snooze, rules engine, built-in translation, and optional WebDAV settings backup.
